sourceNotes: Compiled from ISO technical drawing overview pages and common GB/ISO drawing practice. Use project-specific standards for final release.
drawingRules: Every part drawing needs part name, material, scale, projection method, drawing number, revision, and unit.
Manufacturing drawings need enough views to define geometry without ambiguity.
Functional dimensions, fit dimensions, hole positions, and datum references must be explicit.
Do not use a 3D preview as a substitute for orthographic views.
Assembly drawings need BOM balloons, part list, main mounting dimensions, and assembly notes.
Unspecified tolerances, surface treatment, deburring, and inspection notes should be included when applicable.
